title: Current Progress of Three-year Infant Childminding Service Pilot
what_it_is: Current Progress of Three-year Infant Childminding Service Pilot

sections.label: Childminding pilot launch details
sections.summary: The pilot launches in December 2024 for three years, with details on operators and parent applications to come.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The pilot will be launched in December 2024 for a period of three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: More details will be provided in the coming weeks on the operators appointed onto the pilot, as well as how interested parents can apply for the pilot.

sections.label: Pilot success and childminder recruitment
sections.summary: Success means good parent take-up and sustainable childminder supply; 700 infants need about 250 to 300 childminders at a one-to-two-or-three ratio.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: A successful endpoint would be a good take-up by parents with infants of this service and also a sustainable pipeline of supply of childminders from the operators.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The operators are in charge of recruiting the childminders and when they are looking for these childminders, we will definitely put them in contact with groups, whether it is women groups or the Labour Movement, to extend their outreach to recruit these childminders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have shared earlier that the childminding ratio we are looking at is one childminder to two or three infants.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, in order to cater to 700 infants, which is our first key performance indicator to achieve in this pilot, we would need approximately 250 to 300 childminders.
